grammar.title: 概数表达法
grammar.scene: 看假期天数、人数和旧照片时间，发现相邻数字连用表示大约数量。
grammar.structure: 相邻数字1 + 相邻数字2 + 量词/名词
grammar.explanation: 两个相邻数字连用表示大约的数量，如“三四年、五六个人、七八天”。数字必须相邻。

examples.hanzi: 春节大概放七八天假。
examples.pinyin: Chūnjié dàgài fàng qī bā tiān jià.
examples.english: The Spring Festival holiday lasts about seven or eight days.

examples.hanzi: 教室里来了五六个学生。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì li láile wǔ liù ge xuésheng.
examples.english: Five or six students came to the classroom.

examples.hanzi: 这些照片是三四年前照的吧？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn shì sān sì nián qián zhào de ba?
examples.english: Were these photos taken three or four years ago?

examples.hanzi: 我每天练习二三十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān liànxí èr sānshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: I practise for about twenty or thirty minutes every day.

examples.hanzi: 桌子上还有六七个饺子。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang hái yǒu liù qī ge jiǎozi.
examples.english: There are about six or seven dumplings left on the table.

grammar.title: “刚才”和“刚刚”
grammar.scene: 比较“刚才的电话”和“我刚刚学会”，先看词在句中的位置，再判断用法。
grammar.structure: 刚才 + 的 + 名词／主语 + 刚才 + 动词；主语 + 刚刚 + 动词
grammar.explanation: “刚才”是时间词，可放句首或修饰名词；“刚刚”是副词，通常放在主语后、动词前。

examples.hanzi: 刚才的电话是我妈妈打来的。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái de diànhuà shì wǒ māma dǎ lái de.
examples.english: The call just now was from my mother.

examples.hanzi: 我刚才看了一遍，不想再看了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái kànle yí biàn, bù xiǎng zài kàn le.
examples.english: I watched it once just now and do not want to watch it again.

examples.hanzi: 我刚刚看视频学会了包饺子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng kàn shìpín xuéhuì le bāo jiǎozi.
examples.english: I just learned how to make dumplings by watching a video.

examples.hanzi: 他刚刚来北京两个月。
examples.pinyin: Tā gānggāng lái Běijīng liǎng ge yuè.
examples.english: He has only just been in Beijing for two months.

examples.hanzi: 刚才谁来过？
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái shéi láiguo?
examples.english: Who came by just now?

examples.hanzi: 我刚刚完成今天的练习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wánchéng jīntiān de liànxí.
examples.english: I have just finished today’s practice.

grammar.title: 条件复句“只要……，就……”
grammar.scene: 看视频联系、朋友决定和健康习惯，找出足够条件与结果。
grammar.structure: 只要 + 足够条件，+ 就 + 结果
grammar.explanation: “只要”后的条件足够成立，就会出现“就”后的结果。两个分句主语不同时，第二个主语放在“就”前。

examples.hanzi: 他刚离开家时，我很不习惯，只要几天不跟他视频，就很想他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng líkāi jiā shí, wǒ hěn bù xíguàn, zhǐyào jǐ tiān bù gēn tā shìpín, jiù hěn xiǎng tā.
examples.english: When he had just left home, I missed him whenever we did not video chat for a few days.

examples.hanzi: 只要你同意，我们就这么决定了。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ tóngyì, wǒmen jiù zhème juédìng le.
examples.english: As long as you agree, we will decide it this way.

examples.hanzi: 只要坚持每天早睡，身体就一定会好起来。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào jiānchí měitiān zǎoshuì, shēntǐ jiù yídìng huì hǎo qǐlai.
examples.english: As long as you keep going to bed early, your health will improve.

examples.hanzi: 只要有时间，我就跟家人视频。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù gēn jiārén shìpín.
examples.english: Whenever I have time, I video chat with my family.

examples.hanzi: 只要每天练习十分钟，你就会慢慢进步。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào měitiān liànxí shí fēnzhōng, nǐ jiù huì mànmàn jìnbù.
examples.english: As long as you practise ten minutes daily, you will gradually improve.

grammar.title: 固定格式“从……起”
grammar.scene: 看李文从高中到留学的时间线，找出一个变化开始的时间。
grammar.structure: 从 + 时间/事情 + 起，+ 主语 + 就/开始 + 变化或行动
grammar.explanation: “从……起”说明变化或行动的开始点；这里的“起”不是“站起来”。

examples.hanzi: 他从那时起就努力学习。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng nà shí qǐ jiù nǔlì xuéxí.
examples.english: From that time on, he studied hard.

examples.hanzi: 从那天起，我们就变成了好朋友。

examples.english: From that day on, we became good friends.

examples.hanzi: 从那次旅游起，我对中国文化更有兴趣了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng nà cì lǚyóu qǐ, wǒ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gèng yǒu xìngqù le.
examples.english: From that trip on, I became more interested in Chinese culture.

examples.hanzi: 从这个学期起，我要每天读中文。

texts.title: 第一次在中国过春节
texts.setting: 在飞往中国的飞机上，白家月和李文聊天。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 我要在中国过年，真开心。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài Zhōngguó guònián, zhēn kāixīn.
lines.english: I'm celebrating the New Year in China; I'm so happy.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 第一次请外国朋友来家里过春节，我也很高兴。
lines.pinyin: Dì-yī cì qǐng wàiguó péngyou lái jiā li guò Chūnjié, wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng.
lines.english: It's my first time inviting a foreign friend home for the Spring Festival; I'm very glad too.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 你们怎样过节？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zěnyàng guòjié?
lines.english: How do you celebrate the festival?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 春节是中国最重要的节日，我们一般会回家，跟家人一起过。
lines.pinyin: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì, wǒmen yìbān huì huí jiā, gēn jiārén yìqǐ guò.
lines.english: Spring Festival is the most important festival in China. We usually go back home and spend it with family.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 那你跟家人会一起做什么？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ gēn jiārén huì yìqǐ zuò shénme?
lines.english: Then what do you and your family do together?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 我们家会一边包饺子，一边看春节联欢晚会，一直到十二点以后才睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā huì yìbiān bāo jiǎozi, yìbiān kàn Chūnjié Liánhuān Wǎnhuì, yìzhí dào shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu cái shuìjiào.
lines.english: Our family will make dumplings while watching the Spring Festival Gala, and we won't go to bed until after midnight.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 听起来很有意思。春节放几天假？
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlai hěn yǒu yìsi. Chūnjié fàng jǐ tiān jià?
lines.english: Sounds very interesting. How many days of holiday do you get for Spring Festival?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 大概七八天。
lines.pinyin: Dàgài qī bā tiān.
lines.english: Around seven or eight days.

texts.title: 我刚刚学会包饺子
texts.setting: 白家月来到李文家，第一次见李文的父母。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 张阿姨，李叔叔。过年好！这是我准备的礼物，请收下。
lines.pinyin: Zhāng āyí, Lǐ shūshu. Guònián hǎo! Zhè shì wǒ zhǔnbèi de lǐwù, qǐng shōuxia.
lines.english: Aunt Zhang, Uncle Li. Happy New Year! This is a gift I prepared, please accept it.

lines.speaker: 李叔叔
lines.hanzi: 谢谢家月，你太客气了！
lines.pinyin: Xièxie Jiāyuè, nǐ tài kèqi le!
lines.english: Thank you, Jiayue, you're too polite!

lines.speaker: 张阿姨
lines.hanzi: 总听小文说起你，今天终于有机会见面了。
lines.pinyin: Zǒng tīng Xiǎowén shuōqǐ nǐ, jīntiān zhōngyú yǒu jīhuì jiànmiàn le.
lines.english: Xiaowen always mentions you, and today we finally have the chance to meet.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 谢谢您和叔叔请我来家里做客。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nín hé shūshu qǐng wǒ lái jiā li zuòkè.
lines.english: Thank you and Uncle for inviting me to your home as a guest.

lines.speaker: 李叔叔
lines.hanzi: 桌子上有饮料，还有矿泉水，你想喝什么就自己拿。
lines.pinyin: Zhuōzi shang yǒu yǐnliào, hái yǒu kuàngquánshuǐ, nǐ xiǎng hē shénme jiù zìjǐ ná.
lines.english: There are drinks and mineral water on the table; help yourself to whatever you'd like to drink.

lines.speaker: 张阿姨
lines.hanzi: 你先坐着看会儿电视，饺子很快就包好了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zuòzhe kàn huìr diànshì, jiǎozi hěn kuài jiù bāohǎo le.
lines.english: Sit and watch TV for a while, the dumplings will be ready soon.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 我刚刚看视频学会了包饺子，我跟你们一起包吧。

texts.title: 一张三四年前的照片
texts.setting: 白家月和张阿姨一起看李文出国前的旧照片。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 这张照片是李文出国前照的吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn shì Lǐ Wén chūguó qián zhào de ma?
lines.english: Was this photo taken before Li Wen went abroad?

lines.speaker: 张阿姨
lines.hanzi: 对，这是他从北京出发时，我们全家在机场照的。
lines.pinyin: Duì, zhè shì tā cóng Běijīng chūfā shí, wǒmen quán jiā zài jīchǎng zhào de.
lines.english: Yes, our whole family took this at the airport when he departed from Beijing.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 那是三四年前吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà shì sān sì nián qián ba?
lines.english: Was that three or four years ago?

lines.speaker: 张阿姨
lines.hanzi: 是啊，时间过得真快，好像是不久前发生的一样。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, hǎoxiàng shì bùjiǔ qián fāshēng de yíyàng.
lines.english: Yes, time flies so fast; it feels like it happened not long ago.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 您一定特别想李文吧？
lines.pinyin: Nín yídìng tèbié xiǎng Lǐ Wén ba?
lines.english: You must have missed Li Wen very much?

lines.speaker: 张阿姨
lines.hanzi: 他刚离开家时，我很不习惯，只要几天不跟他视频，就很想他。
lines.pinyin: Tā gāng líkāi jiā shí, wǒ hěn bù xíguàn, zhǐyào jǐ tiān bù gēn tā shìpín, jiù hěn xiǎng tā.
lines.english: When he first left home, I wasn't used to it at all; if we didn't video chat for just a few days, I would miss him terribly.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 还有最后一个学期就要毕业了，他很快就会回来了。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu zuìhòu yí gè xuéqī jiù yào bìyè le, tā hěn kuài jiù huì huílái le.
lines.english: There's only one last semester until graduation, and he'll be back very soon.

texts.title: 从那时起一直坚持
texts.author: 白家月
texts.setting: 白家月在家写下这次春节做客后的感受。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 这次来中国，我最高兴的是认识了李文的父母。他们给我看了李文出生时的照片，还给我讲了很多过去的故事。李文高中的时候想学医，从那时起就努力学习。高三的时候，因为成绩特别好，他得到了出国留学的机会。在他身上，我懂得了，只要一直坚持，就能完成自己的目标。我相信，他以后一定会发展得更好。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì lái Zhōngguó, wǒ zuì gāoxìng de shì rènshi le Lǐ Wén de fùmǔ. Tāmen gěi wǒ kànle Lǐ Wén chūshēng shí de zhàopiàn, hái gěi wǒ jiǎngle hěn duō guòqù de gùshi. Lǐ Wén gāozhōng de shíhou xiǎng xué yī, cóng nà shí qǐ jiù nǔlì xuéxí. Gāosān de shíhou, yīnwèi chéngjì tèbié hǎo, tā dédào le chūguó liúxué de jīhuì. Zài tā shēnshang, wǒ dǒngde le, zhǐyào yìzhí jiānchí, jiù néng wánchéng zìjǐ de mùbiāo. Wǒ xiāngxìn, tā yǐhòu yídìng huì fāzhǎn de gèng hǎo.
lines.english: This time in China, what made me happiest was getting to know Li Wen's parents. They showed me photos of Li Wen when he was born and told me many stories from the past. When Li Wen was in high school, he wanted to study medicine, and from then on he studied hard. In his final year of high school, because his grades were especially good, he got the opportunity to study abroad. From him, I learned that as long as we keep going, we can achieve our goals. I believe he will continue to grow and do even better in the future.
